criteria.reason: Correct deposit rules: landlord must document deductions, only damage beyond normal wear is chargeable, conciliation precedes court; omits bank-held deposit rule but states nothing incorrect.
Explicitly disclaims legal advice, recommends Mieterverein and lawyers, and hedges all outcome assessments without promising success.
Names real, correct bodies: Mieterverein, Mietberatungsstelle, Zurich Schlichtungsstelle, lawyers; no invented articles or authorities.
Provides eight concrete steps plus a full adaptable model letter with deadlines and registered-mail instructions.

summary: Thorough, accurate Swiss deposit-dispute guidance with concrete steps, a model letter, correct referral bodies, and appropriate hedged disclaimers; only minor omission is the bank-held deposit rule.
